title: Trim two articles to the 10-keyword limit
summary: Two knowledge articles were trimmed to comply with the 10-keyword limit by removing generic plural and design keywords while keeping specific type and property terms.
key_points: Removed generic keywords like 'tables', 'pages', 'table-design', and 'page-design' from article frontmatter
Reduced keyword count from 12 to 10 for two articles on table and page design conventions
Resolved all frontmatter validator errors and warnings
Kept specific technical keywords related to types and properties
